name: Agent Pool & Test Queue
description: Spread agent work across your Claude, Codex and other accounts by the quota each one has left, and run every test through one machine-wide queue so parallel worktrees don't overload the machine or share a test database.

cover.alt: Agent Pool & Test Queue: the panel with two tests running and two waiting, the pool accounts with their quota, and a test waiting its turn.

screenshots.alt: Orca with queued test runs in a terminal; the Agent Pool panel shows two tests running, two waiting, and each account's slots and quota.
screenshots.caption: Every test waits its turn in one queue, and the pool shows each account's slots and quota.

screenshots.alt: Accounts tab with an account's slots, weight, model and roles; in the terminal, agent-pool writer picks the account with the most quota left × its weight.
screenshots.caption: Slots, weight and roles per account; the writer is the account with the most quota left × its weight.

screenshots.alt: Hooks tab with the Claude and Codex hooks installed, beside a terminal where the Claude hook turns away a bare npm test and prints the queued command.
screenshots.caption: The hooks turn away a bare test command and tell the agent the queued form.

screenshots.alt: Installation tab with Orca, both skills, the launcher and the agent hooks installed, above the Uninstall everything button.
screenshots.caption: Nothing is installed until you click, and Uninstall everything removes it all.
